settings.advanced.intro: These tools export wallpapers, maintain preview cache, and clear local data. Operations only affect this extension's storage.
settings.advanced.wallpaper.title: Wallpaper Tools
settings.advanced.wallpaper.export.title: Export Current Wallpaper
settings.advanced.wallpaper.export.desc: Save the current Bing, custom image, or video wallpaper to your browser's download folder.
settings.advanced.preview.title: Preview Maintenance

settings.advanced.preview.clear.title: Clear Preview Buffer
settings.advanced.preview.clear.desc: Delete preview cache for Bing, image, and video wallpapers; current wallpaper will not be deleted.
settings.advanced.preview.regen.title: Regenerate Current Preview
settings.advanced.preview.regen.desc: Capture a new low-res preview from current wallpaper and update preview color.
settings.advanced.preview.repick.title: Repick Preview Color
settings.advanced.preview.repick.desc: Recalculate placeholder color from current preview or wallpaper without regenerating preview image.

settings.advanced.storage.clearBing.desc: Delete cached latest Bing wallpaper; next use will re-download.
settings.advanced.backup.title: Settings backup
settings.advanced.backup.export.title: Export settings
settings.advanced.backup.export.desc: Save every setting and the language choice as a JSON file to restore on another browser or machine. Wallpaper files are not included.
settings.advanced.backup.import.title: Import settings
settings.advanced.backup.import.desc: Restore settings from a backup file. This overwrites the current settings (wallpaper files are unaffected).
